# A composite literal used as argument in a type conversion or function call,
# and inside a function literal body, in an if condition.
ex {
	A -> B

-- x.go --
package m

type A struct{ X int }
type B struct{ X int }

type I interface{}

func f() {
	_ = I(A{1})
	if func() int { return A{X: 1}.X }() > 0 {
	}
}
